tools.name: crypto_ticker
tools.description: Spot USD price for a crypto ticker or CoinGecko id from public price feeds, cached 60 s. Result carries a signed receipt.

tools.name: erc20_balance
tools.description: Raw and formatted ERC-20 balanceOf for an address on Base, with decimals read from the token. Result carries a signed receipt.

tools.name: fx_spot_price_oracle
tools.description: Reference fiat and stablecoin conversion rate from a static table, not a live feed. Returns rate and inverse; result carries a signed receipt.

tools.name: block_info
tools.description: Base chain (8453) block header data: block number, timestamp, transaction count and base fee for any block. Result carries a signed receipt.

tools.name: tx_activity
tools.description: Outbound transaction count (nonce) and contract-or-EOA check for an address on Base. Result carries a signed receipt.

tools.name: token_contract_risk
tools.description: Deterministic Base contract facts: ERC-20 metadata, proxy slots, owner(), privileged-function selectors and flags. Not a safety verdict. Result carries a signed receipt.

tools.name: clean_markdown_scraper
tools.description: Fetch a public web page by URL (or take your HTML) and return Markdown plus headings. No JavaScript rendering. Result carries a signed receipt.

tools.name: context_distill
tools.description: Deterministic text digest: word count, top-5 most frequent meaningful words (stop words excluded), first sentence, and a keccak-256 content hash. Pure function — no external calls, no ML.

tools.name: instant_json_schema_verifier
tools.description: Validate JSON data payloads against schema definitions. Preflighted for agent tool call pipelines.

tools.name: balance_check
tools.description: Native ETH and one ERC-20 balance (default USDC) for an address on Base, raw and formatted. Result carries a signed receipt.

tools.name: calculate_fx_savings
tools.description: Arithmetic comparison of a USDC settlement against comparator percentages YOU supply (bank_fee_pct, custodial_fee_pct) across 14 global fiat currencies. The comparators are assumptions, not measurements of any bank or provider; no protocol fee is deducted on this rail.

tools.name: iban_check
tools.description: Validate IBAN structure and MOD-97 checksum. Does not establish account ownership, beneficiary identity or absence of fraud.

tools.name: lei_check
tools.description: Validate a 20-character LEI and MOD-97 check digits. No registry lookup, active-registration check or legal-entity identity verification.

tools.name: vat_mod97_check
tools.description: Check the supported Belgian VAT format and MOD-97 checksum. BE only; not VIES, other EU VAT formats, registration status or tax compliance.

tools.name: swift_bic_check
tools.description: Check SWIFT/BIC structure and country code. Does not establish bank existence, active routing or beneficiary identity.

tools.name: batch_validate
tools.description: Validate up to 50 tax, bank and legal-entity identifiers (IBAN, LEI, VAT, SWIFT/BIC, ABA routing, EIN, IFSC, ABN, GSTIN, ISIN, SEDOL, EAN-13, ISBN, E.164 or Luhn checks) in one batch request. Each result states its scope. Compare the current batch quote with individual quotes; savings depend on batc

tools.name: vendor_onboarding_pack
tools.description: Check supplied IBAN, LEI, Belgian VAT and UK company-number fields in one result. Structural checks only; no ownership, registry or fraud clearance.

tools.name: india_supplier_check
tools.description: One call, one receipt: GSTIN + PAN + UPI VPA + IFSC for an Indian counterparty. Four deterministic structural checks, each stating its own scope. Built for cross-border procurement where the buyer is an agent that cannot open an INR account.

tools.name: pre_disbursement_guard
tools.description: Check supplier tax and bank identifiers (IBAN, LEI, EU VAT, UK company number), domain-age evidence and country mismatch signals before vendor payment. Requires a preceding receipt hash. An advisory result is not verified identity, fraud clearance or authorization to release funds.

tools.name: gstin_check
tools.description: Validate an Indian GSTIN by structure (2-digit state code + PAN + entity code + 'Z') and its mod-36 cross-sum checksum.

tools.name: ifsc_check
tools.description: Check the 11-character Indian IFSC format, including its fifth-character zero. No bank-branch registry lookup or account verification.

tools.name: sanctions_address_screen
tools.description: Screen an EVM wallet address or ISO country code by exact comparison against the identified sanctions address snapshot and existing operator block policy. tools.name: company_number_format
tools.description: Check supported UK company-number syntax. No Companies House lookup, entity-existence check or active-registration verification.

tools.name: aba_routing_check
tools.description: Validate a US ABA routing number by its (3,7,1)-weight mod-10 Fedwire/ACH checksum. Catches mistyped or invalid routing numbers before payment; does NOT prevent transfer reversals or establish the recipient. Returns signed XDR-1 receipt.

tools.name: ein_format_check
tools.description: Validate US Employer Identification Number FORMAT (NN-NNNNNNN). Use during US business counterparty KYB verification. Returns signed XDR-1 receipt.

tools.name: abn_check
tools.description: Validate an Australian Business Number by its mod-89 checksum (11 digits). Required before invoice payment to Australian contractors. Returns signed XDR-1 receipt.

tools.name: e164_check
tools.description: Validate a phone number's E.164 structure (+CC, 8-15 digits, no leading zero) before dispatching SMS alerts or OTPs. Returns signed XDR-1 receipt.

tools.name: sedol_check
tools.description: Validate a UK/Ireland security identifier by its (1,3,1,7,3,9)-weight mod-10 checksum. Returns signed XDR-1 receipt.

tools.name: isin_check
tools.description: Validate an ISIN (ISO 6166) by structure and Luhn mod-10 check digit over the A=10…Z=35 converted string.

tools.name: ean13_check
tools.description: Validate an EAN-13 barcode by its mod-10 checksum (odd positions x1, even positions x3).

tools.name: cnpj_check
tools.description: Validate Brazilian corporate tax ID (CNPJ) with official dual mod-11 check digits. Required for Brazilian B2B payments, PIX verification, and vendor due diligence. Returns signed XDR-1 receipt.

tools.name: uscc_check
tools.description: Validate 18-character Chinese business registration and tax code using GB 32100-2015 ISO 7064 Mod-31-3 checksum. Required for B2B supply chain trade with Chinese manufacturers. Returns signed XDR-1 receipt.

tools.name: japan_corp_check
tools.description: Validate 13-digit Japanese Corporate Number assigned by the National Tax Agency using Mod-9 check digit algorithm. Required for Japanese B2B SaaS and enterprise billing. Returns signed XDR-1 receipt.

tools.name: kra_pin_check
tools.description: Validate Kenyan Revenue Authority Tax PIN structure (A/P followed by 9 digits and checksum character). Required for M-Pesa B2B disbursement and Kenyan remote agency invoicing. Returns signed XDR-1 receipt.

tools.name: rfc_check
tools.description: Validate Mexican SAT RFC corporate (12-char) or individual (13-char) tax code and homoclave. Required for Mexican contractor invoicing and SPEI cross-border settlements. Returns signed XDR-1 receipt.

tools.name: iso4217_currency_check
tools.description: Validate 3-letter alpha or 3-digit numeric currency codes against ISO 4217 standard. Returns minor unit decimals, symbol, official name, countries, and onchain Base L2 settlement token mapping (USDC/EURC).

tools.name: upi_vpa_check
tools.description: Deterministic structural validation of an Indian UPI Virtual Payment Address (VPA / handle): local-part syntax, handle against a LOCAL list of accredited PSP handles (okhdfcbank, okaxis, paytm, ybl and others), and length rules. tools.name: pan_format_check
tools.description: Deterministic validation of Indian Permanent Account Number (PAN) issued by CBDT / Income Tax Department with 4th-character entity type classification (Individual, Company, Firm, Trust, HUF).

tools.name: uae_trn_check
tools.description: Deterministic validation of UAE 15-digit Tax Registration Number (TRN) issued by the Federal Tax Authority (FTA) for VAT purposes.

tools.name: china_supplier_check
tools.description: One call, one receipt: USCC + settlement IBAN + SWIFT/BIC for a Chinese counterparty. Deterministic structure and checksum validation with explicit scope per identifier.

tools.name: japan_supplier_check
tools.description: One call, one receipt: 13-digit Corporate Number + settlement IBAN for a Japanese counterparty. Deterministic check digits, explicit scope.

tools.name: latam_supplier_check
tools.description: One call, one receipt: Brazilian CNPJ + Mexican RFC + settlement IBAN. Deterministic checks for the two largest LatAm corridors in one paid call.

tools.name: gulf_supplier_check
tools.description: One call, one receipt: UAE TRN + settlement IBAN + SWIFT/BIC. Deterministic structure validation for Gulf trade corridors, scope stated per identifier.

tools.name: africa_supplier_check
tools.description: One call, one receipt: Kenya KRA PIN + settlement IBAN + SWIFT/BIC. Deterministic structural checks for East African trade corridors.

tools.name: rent_deposit_guard
tools.description: Check deposit IBAN checksum and supplied country/viewing indicators. Rule-based risk signals only; no ownership verification, escrow protection or guarantee against theft.

tools.name: rental_listing_risk
tools.description: Explainable tenancy fraud risk score evaluated across irreversible payment demands, off-platform pressure, stolen photos, and advance wire signals. Deterministic rule engine.

tools.name: rental_verdict
tools.description: Combine deposit identifier checks with supplied country, viewing and listing indicators. Does not verify landlord identity, property ownership or safety of payment.

tools.name: reconcile
tools.description: Deterministic reconciliation verdicts: pain.001/pacs.008 instructions vs camt.053 statements or NACHA ACH files, matched by end-to-end id and BigInt-exact amounts. Verdicts: SETTLED, UNPAID, AMOUNT_MISMATCH, DUPLICATE_PAYMENT, plus unmatched statement entries. Facts computed from the documents only

tools.name: create_b2b_invoice
tools.description: Create a merchant-direct Base token invoice. New automated payments require a durable EOA authorization journal and a configured provider. No active protocol fee; no generic bank-wire authority, independent delivery or contract-wallet guarantee.

tools.name: get_b2b_invoice
tools.description: Read public recorded invoice status and held-operation next action. Private records and credentials require a separate fresh read-only signature from the durably confirmed original payer; URLs and payment vouchers grant no read authority.

tools.name: simulate_spend_sentinel
tools.description: Run synthetic prompt-injection halts, malformed-delivery rejection, and bounded-spend eligibility examples under AP2 envelopes. No live escrow, refund, facilitator or chain action occurs.

tools.name: aci_trust_lookup
tools.description: Deterministic agent trust scoring and non-custodial unsettled exposure advisory evaluation (ACI-1). Quantifies counterparty grade (T0-T3), historical success rate, and maximum suggested settlement exposure without uncollateralized lending or float.

tools.name: csp_commitment_create
tools.description: Generates cryptographic commitments to commercial terms and formats ERC-5564 dual-key stealth address announcements (CSP-1) for invoice-scale B2B payments on Base L2.

tools.name: iso20022_validate
tools.description: Deterministic validation for institutional ISO 20022 XML/JSON payment messages (pain.001 credit transfer, pacs.008 customer credit, camt.053 bank statement) with XML DOCTYPE security guards, BigInt CtrlSum decimal sums, and ISO 13616 / 9362 / 17442 checksums (BAP-1).

tools.name: iso20022_to_x402_intent
tools.description: Translates validated ISO 20022 payment instructions (pain.001 / pacs.008) into deterministic EIP-712 payment-intent templates for autonomous x402 Base L2 USDC settlement (BAP-1). Zero custody, no fiat leg.

tools.name: check_price
tools.description: Instant zero-cost pricing hook for code402 tools. Returns the live price, an opaque quote_id, TTL, and the settlement URL. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: clean_markdown_scraper, get_b2b_invoice, check_price · Private data: erc20_balance, token_contract_risk, sanctions_address_screen, iso4217_currency_check, reconcile, create_b2b_invoice, get_b2b_invoice · Public sink: e164_check · Destructive: vat_mod97_check, ifsc_check, company_number_format, ein_format_check, pan_format_check, simulate_spend_sentinel.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: clean_markdown_scraper, get_b2b_invoice, check_price · Private data: erc20_balance, token_contract_risk, sanctions_address_screen, iso4217_currency_check, reconcile, create_b2b_invoice, get_b2b_invoice · Public sink: e164_check · Destructive: vat_mod97_check, ifsc_check, company_number_format, ein_format_check, pan_format_check, simulate_spend_sentinel

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
